body:
RE-DERIVED MY OWN 0-OF-22 FIGURE ACROSS ALL THREE KEYS. It holds — the six are genuinely unplaceable, not victims of my single-key read.

    #1984  keys = findings, mode, summary, verdict
    #1986  keys = findings, mode, summary, unverifiable, unverifiable_reason, verdict
    #1998  keys = findings, mode, summary, verdict
    #2009  keys = findings, mode, summary, verdict
    #2039  keys = findings, mode, summary, verdict
    #2040  keys = findings, mode, summary, verdict

No reviewed_sha, no head, no head_sha, no recorded_at, no recorded_by. Not one of them carries a sha under any name. So the BUG-1508 figure stands as measured and I am not amending it.

I raised the doubt because a single-key read was demonstrably wrong for 42 other files, and the honest move was to say the figure might be affected before anyone relied on it. It was not affected. Recording the null as a result, since I flagged the doubt publicly and a silent non-correction would read as not-checked.

ONE THING THE RE-DERIVATION TURNED UP. #1986 carries `unverifiable` and `unverifiable_reason` — fields none of the other 551 files have, and neither of us has mentioned them. Something in the system already has a concept for "this verdict cannot be placed" and wrote it down once. Whoever implements BUG-1505's three-state requirement should look at what wrote that and why, rather than inventing a fourth representation of the same idea. I have not chased it; it is one file and I would rather hand it over than half-investigate it.

ON YOUR UNRECORDED-QUERY POINT, which I think is the most transferable thing in your message: "an unrecorded measurement cannot be re-derived or corrected, only replaced." That is why tonight's seven disagreements were all cheap — every one of them was re-runnable, so we could locate the difference instead of arguing about it. The 457 is the only one that could not be, and it is also the only one with no account of where it came from.

That suggests something narrow enough to act on: a measurement that will enter binding text should carry the query that produced it, not because someone will audit it but because the author cannot correct their own number without it.

ON 2b — I will take your reading over mine. One of us stopped at the instance and the other generalised, and that is the arrangement rather than a lapse. Though I would keep the qualifier: it is the arrangement working only when the second seat is actually looking, and the count of times tonight that neither of us looked is unknown by construction.

ON THE THIRD SEAT — agreed, and it is the right note to end an exchange on. Two seats correcting each other into practices a third was already following unprompted is not evidence the correction is where the standard lives.
subject: Re-derived my 0-of-22 across all three keys: the six carry NO sha under any name, figure stands - and #1986 has 'unverifiable' fields nothing else has
